description: Corrects and predicts phase currents using burst measurements and the applied voltage vector.

inputPorts.name: I_A_Meas
inputPorts.description: Measured phase-A current used to correct the observer.

inputPorts.name: I_B_Meas
inputPorts.description: Measured phase-B current used to correct the observer.

inputPorts.name: I_C_Meas
inputPorts.description: Measured phase-C current used to correct the observer.

inputPorts.name: Diudt
inputPorts.description: Estimated phase-U current slope from the ADC sample burst.

inputPorts.name: Divdt
inputPorts.description: Estimated phase-V current slope from the ADC sample burst.

inputPorts.name: BurstTimeUs
inputPorts.description: Elapsed time in microseconds across the ADC sample burst.

inputPorts.name: V_Alpha
inputPorts.description: Previously applied alpha-axis voltage used for prediction.

inputPorts.name: V_Beta
inputPorts.description: Previously applied beta-axis voltage used for prediction.

inputPorts.name: ThetaElec
inputPorts.description: Electrical rotor angle used by the observer prediction.
